<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Petshop Atsargu Laukimas v1.0 (Back-in-stock "Pranesti kai bus")
 * Description: Klientas out-of-stock prekes puslapyje palieka el. pasta; prekei grizus i prekyba issiunciamas laiskas per Petshop_Email_Dispatch (flow back_in_stock, transactional).
 * Version: 1.0.0
 */
if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) { exit; }

class Petshop_Atsargu_Laukimas {

	const VERSIJA        = '1.0.0';
	const RATE_PER_IP    = 5;   // uzklausu per valanda is vieno IP
	const RATE_PER_EMAIL = 10;  // uzklausu per para vienam el. pastui

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Inicijavimas                                                     */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	public static function init() {
		add_action( 'init', array( __CLASS__, 'maybe_install' ) );
		add_action( 'rest_api_init', array( __CLASS__, 'routes' ) );
		add_filter( 'petshop_email_flows', array( __CLASS__, 'registruoti_srauta' ) );
		add_action( 'woocommerce_single_product_summary', array( __CLASS__, 'forma' ), 31 );
		// Prekes lygio likutis (paprastos prekes + tevas)
		add_action( 'woocommerce_product_set_stock_status', array( __CLASS__, 'statusas_pasikeite' ), 20, 3 );
		// Variacijos likutis -> pranesame apie TEVA (klientas uzsisake prekes puslapyje)
		add_action( 'woocommerce_variation_set_stock_status', array( __CLASS__, 'variacijos_statusas' ), 20, 3 );
	}

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Lentele                                                          */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	public static function table() {
		global $wpdb;
		return $wpdb->prefix . 'ps_stock_watch';
	}

	public static function maybe_install() {
		if ( get_option( 'ps_stock_watch_db' ) === self::VERSIJA ) { return; }
